title: console-tooling-standup-2026-07-14
body:
Attendees: Jordan, Aisha, Mira, Diego, Samira

Notes:
- Quick sync on current canary rollout for model route UI changes (feature flag: feature/route-ui-v2). Canary at 10% prod traffic since Monday — metrics stable so far.
- Analytics: front-end latency p50 increased ~20ms on canary page load during peak (12:00-13:00 PDT). Backend API tokenization call latency unchanged — likely client-side render diff. Mira to profile bundle and devtools trace.
- Rollouts: automatic rollback policy tested in staging. Canary will auto-failover to v1 if error rate > 2% sustained for 5m. No rollbacks so far.
- UI: new settings modal for per-route model pinning pushed to staging. Diego working on accessibility fixes (keyboard nav, focus states). Target to merge by EOD Thursday.
- Analytics dashboards: Aisha created a per-route cost-per-token dashboard; needs minor query tweaks (group by model_variant). Asking infra/observability for retention increase for token-level traces for 14 days.
- Bugs: two regressions reported from QA: (1) empty state for rollouts page shows spinner forever — reproduced, PR open (#987). (2) CSV export column order mismatch — low severity, scheduled for next sprint.
- SRE input: Samira flagged that canary traffic routing added a new route tag; alerting rules need update to include route_tag in grouping. She will open JIRA JIRA-4321 to track.
- Security/compliance: no PII in logs for the new analytics pipeline. Confirmed with security that current sampling is acceptable.

Blockers / Open Questions:
- Need confirmation from infra if we can increase observability retention to 14 days (cost impact?). Aisha to follow up with Ravi (infra).
- Design question: should per-route default model be editable by non-admins? Product to decide; Jordan to run quick poll with CS and PMs.
- Can the UI team get a short-term perf budget to split the bundle and lazy-load analytics widgets? Diego to propose approach with rough ETA.

Action items (owners):
- Mira: profile and prioritize client bundle perf issues on canary pages; report findings by 2026-07-16.
- Diego: finish accessibility fixes and merge settings modal PR; target 2026-07-16. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/987.
- Aisha: update cost-per-token dashboard queries, request observability retention bump with infra.
- Samira: update alerting groups to include new route_tag and create JIRA-4321 for tracking.
- Jordan: poll CS/PM on permissions model for per-route editing; summarize by next standup.

Upcoming:
- Next canary expansion planned for 2026-07-20 (to 25%) pending perf profile results.
- Sprint planning for sprint-29 next Monday; document to include analytics tech debt items and CSV export fix.

Notes to self:
- Keep the canary small until we have client-side perf < +10ms p50 delta.
- Remind infra to run cost impact estimate before increasing trace retention.

Meeting adjourned.
